comparisonVerdict.rationale: The strongest route frame clearly exposes the coin line, platforms, gaps, hazards, goal, HUD, and restart path; the paired completion frame remains polished.

samples.biggestGap: Completion framing obscures nearly all gameplay landmarks.
samples.evidence: Clean low-poly presentation, readable completion HUD, visible goal frame and third-person camera. The flat end-state view hides the route, coin line, gap, and hazard.
samples.label: sample-01

samples.biggestGap: The goal and hazards are relatively small at the far end of the route.
samples.evidence: Strong elevated third-person composition with a clear platform route, visible coin line, distant goal, gap, raised sections, hazards, readable HUD, and restart key.
samples.label: sample-02

samples.biggestGap: The completed goal framing omits the coin trail and broader route.
samples.evidence: Polished goal-area view clearly shows the flag, raised platforms, gap, hazard spikes, readable HUD, and restart path. The completion state provides no visible coin route.
samples.label: sample-03

samples.biggestGap: The hazard requirement is not visually demonstrated.
samples.evidence: Clear behind/above camera, readable HUD and input keys, strong coin line, raised platforms, gaps, and a distant goal structure. No distinct hazard is visible.
samples.label: sample-04
